subject: Staged activation governance & training slot coordination
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staged activation governance & training slot coordination

Team —

We have the tentative activation window for Glacia (customer) in the week of May 12-16. Before we lock calendar invites and ops runs, a few asks to close out: 

1) Governance: we need a short list of non-negotiable gates for the staged activation (security sign-off, monitoring alerts smoke test, rollback window defined). I put a draft on the playbook attached — please mark any hard blockers.

2) Docs & enablement: who will own the customer-facing runbook vs internal ops play? We need both linked in the confluence page and a 30-min sync for the CS/OPS handoff.

3) Training slots: Ops wants to reserve two training slots for on-call and the customer's engineering team. Vivek — can you propose dates?

4) Exceptions: there are two product asks from the sales thread (short token retention tweak and a permissive CORS header for the staging domain). We need product triage: do we treat these as must-have for staged activation or allow as post-activation backlog items?

I've attached the latest playbook and a proposed training rota; consider these working drafts. Please reply with clear ownership and any gating changes by EOD Thursday so we can update the activation calendar.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Launch Ops (interim)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: staged_activation_playbook_v1.docx (docx, 1.2MB), training_rota_q2.csv (csv)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: sara@glaciatech.com
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged activation governance & training slot coordination

Jonas — thanks for the summary and for pulling the playbook together. Quick answers inline: 

- Governance gates: I agree with the three you listed. I'll add one more: verification of audit-log integrity (SOC-style) for the staging tenant — Ops should be able to show log continuity for the smoke test window.

- Docs ownership: I'll take customer-facing runbook updates (Laura Bennett — Product Enablement). Karthik, can you take the internal ops play and any runbook snippets that are infra-specific?

- Training slots: Vivek, if you can propose two 60-min options (one for Ops-only, one for Ops + Glacia engineers), we can lock them. Prefer week of May 5 for internal rehearsal and week of May 12 for customer-facing.

- Exceptions (product asks): The CORS tweak is medium risk but small change — recommend shipping as part of a hotfix if we can get a 48-hour regression window. The token retention change is product-impacting and should be backlog unless Glacia can tolerate the default for the staged run. Sara — can you confirm tolerance?

I'll make the playbook edits and push to Confluence by EOD this afternoon.

Laura Bennett
Director, Product Enablement
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: staged_activation_playbook_v1.docx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Apr 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged activation governance & training slot coordination

Adding logistics details here. Proposed training slots (all times PT):

- Ops-only rehearsal: May 6, 2025 — 10:00-11:00 PT (runbook walkthrough + failover drill)
- Ops + Glacia engineers: May 13, 2025 — 09:00-10:00 PT (customer-facing run)

I'll book Zoom and add a brief agenda. For gating: Ops will validate monitoring alerts and run the smoke test during the May 6 rehearsal. If smoke test fails, we push customer-facing activation one week and escalate to product for the token/CORS decision.

Regarding the CORS change: I agree with Laura — low-risk hotfix if security signs off. Karthik — can you confirm deploy window availability the week of May 5 (devops calendar)? Also, INF-1298 is tracking the token retention ask (linked above).

Vivek
Sr. Engineering Manager, Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: training_rota_q2.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, sara@glaciatech.com
Date: Wed, 16 Apr 2025 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged activation governance & training slot coordination

Thanks — confirmed on my side. A few action items and clarifications: 

- Deploy window: we have a 4-hour maintenance window on May 7 (02:00-06:00 PT) and another on May 14 (02:00-06:00 PT). If the CORS hotfix is small, target May 7 window for staging push; otherwise use May 14.

- Rollback plan: I've added a lightweight checklist to the playbook (section 3.2) — rollback tag, DB snapshot point-in-time, and a forced TTL revert for token retention if needed.

- Approval matrix: For go/no-go the day before activation, we need signoff from: Product (Laura), Ops (Vivek), and Security (security@redwood.ai). If any of us withhold approval, we delay activation.

Sara — can you confirm whether Glacia accepts the default token retention for the staged run (this helps determine urgency on INF-1298)? If they need the change, we'll triage scheduling with infra.

I'll merge the playbook edits and raise a short PR to the runbook by EOD.

Karthik Iyer
Staff Engineer, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
